picks.editorial_note: A $100M NSF program to build regional AI compute infrastructure and workforce pipelines marks one of the largest federal investments this week, with the broadest potential reach across the academic AI ecosystem.
picks.title: New NSF State and Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs will power AI-enabled scientific research across the country

picks.editorial_note: NIST's formal MOU with the DOE Office of Science to join the White House-led Genesis Mission signals a coordinated national policy push to accelerate AI-driven science, elevating it to a top federal priority.
picks.title: NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $50M investment in two Materials Innovation Platforms gives researchers nationwide access to autonomous AI-driven experimentation infrastructure, a significant bet on self-driving labs as the future of materials science.
picks.title: NSF stands up 2 Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M investment

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's $24.9M NSF-funded national self-driving laboratory for metals discovery, open to researchers nationwide, exemplifies the shift toward shared autonomous-AI research infrastructure at scale.
picks.title: Texas A&M to build self-driving laboratory for metals, open to researchers nationwide – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: A $20M NSF grant to build an AI-enabled cloud semiconductor lab at Virginia Tech expands the federal Genesis Mission's automated-lab network into chip fabrication research.
picks.title: University receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor lab
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: RPI's selection for two DOE Genesis Mission projects, including AI-guided rare-earth materials discovery with a national lab, demonstrates concrete scientific traction from the new federal AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: RPI Selected for Two U.S. Department of Energy Genesis Mission Projects

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's deployment of the first AI-driven telescope is a genuine scientific first, showing how autonomous AI systems can directly operate frontline research instruments.
picks.title: First AI-driven telescope goes stargazing

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's leadership of a national Programmable Cloud Laboratory for advanced manufacturing cements its role as a hub in the emerging federal network of AI-driven autonomous research facilities.
picks.title: Georgia Tech to Lead National Cloud Laboratory for Advanced Manufacturing and Materials

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's new AI framework combining thermodynamics and machine learning to predict solid-state reaction pathways is a substantive methodological advance for accelerating materials synthesis.
picks.title: New AI Modeling Approach Accelerates the Development of Advanced Materials

picks.editorial_note: HKU's atomically thin in-memory search chip offers a credible hardware path around the von Neumann bottleneck, a notable advance for energy-efficient AI computing.
picks.title: HKU Engineering develops atomically thin “analogue in-memory search” chip to redefine AI computing limits with minimalist architecture - All News - Media - HKU
